content: Probably a good idea to remove your watch if it's mechanical.  I put lube on the screw threads to make it easier to screw them down.  I left installing the collets to the end as they seem likely to fall out.

keep in mind, these magnets are STRONG.

if you have them to close they might attracct each other nd break in half, something I have just done. 

IF that is the case, you can put them together below another magne, put them in the hole and slide the top magnet of hilst holding the bottom magnet in place and screwing it tight.
Pre-tap M3 threads into the part before attempting to hand-tighten these screws.

Don't tighten the magnets completely down!!
Leave them enough room, so they can be pushed out by the rod magnets inserted earlier. When all magnets are inserted, the ring magnets should hover and lift about ~0.5mm out of their casing (there are indents in the holder part for this reason).
If the magnets are tighten down, the filament sensor won't reliably reset when the filament is removed.
